pages.text: Denken's follow-up: within four seconds of your Waldgose, turn its cyclone into a roaring fire tornado. Five levels. Does not set blocks on fire. Damage: 1.8× spell power within 3 + level blocks of the Waldgose, and burning for 3 + level seconds.
